text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: It's finally, finally, finally here! I'm running against Oguri today in the Mile Championship! The clash of destiny I've waited for since I was a kid is here!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Thank you for believing in my dream, Trainer! Thank you so, so, so much!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Today, my dream comes true! I'm gonna transform this race against my ultimate rival into one that'll inspire dreams in everyone!
